This release fixes a crash in the charging helper.

## Fixes

- The charging helper crashed every time Fullstop quit or stopped using it, which left crash reports named `FullstopHelper` in Console. It now exits cleanly. Charging was never affected: the helper reconnects the power adapter before exiting, and macOS starts it again when Fullstop needs it.

Updating from an earlier version may produce one last crash report, because the old helper is still running when the old version quits.

## Install

Download `Fullstop.dmg` below, open it, and drag Fullstop to your Applications folder, replacing the old version. If you already have Fullstop, it updates itself. Fullstop needs a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 27 or later.

The app and disk image are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. To check your download, compare it with `Fullstop.dmg.sha256`, or verify its build provenance:

```sh
gh attestation verify Fullstop.dmg --repo firatciftci/fullstop
```
